name: CaptureKit · Your landing page, as each country sees it.
alt: Animated infographic: CaptureKit, Massive and your code in a stack card, then three tall browser windows showing the same landing page as it loads in the US, Germany and Japan via Massive, each with a different layout. A new day starts and a red capture bar runs down each full page in turn as it scrolls, and each finished screenshot drops into a filmstrip of dated PNGs beside yesterday's. The request card highlights the proxy for the country being captured. Headline: Your landing page, as each country sees it.
